worlds.scene: Stylized miniature city of generic business types (coffee shop, tech tower, sneaker boutique, media studio, grocery) with ownership sparkles. Note: contains one small diegetic 'STUDIO' sign (generic word, not a brand).
Golden light/coin streams flowing through channels between buildings — how money moves through a business.
Castle company on an island ringed by a glowing teal moat — the competitive-advantage 'moat' metaphor.
Aerial map of color-coded sector neighborhoods (tech / food / healthcare / energy / finance) connected by roads — diversification.
Serene market mountain with a winding path to a glowing summit through clouds — the patient long-term journey.
